description: This walk takes you from Borth to Talybont in Ceredigion. The route runs for a distance of about 3 miles, following a section of the waymarked Borth to Devil's Bridge Walk between the two settlements. Starting on the coast at Borth you head east through some pleasant countryside to the neighbouring village of Talybont. You can continue your walking in the area on the Aberystwyth to Borth Walk .
